curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42111-1-1.pdf (one book, 236 pages; the car is built on pages 13-227, and pages 228-229 show the functions)

functions.does: The black gear on the rear shelf behind the roof steers the front wheels (hand of God steering): its upright shaft turns, through bevel gears, a shaft running forward through the car to the steering rack between the front wheels.
functions.source: book: page 228 bottom-left inset (arrow on the gear behind the roof)

functions.does: Rolling the car turns the V8 engine: the rear wheels drive the differential, whose ring gear turns a drive shaft running forward under the car through a universal joint; at the front a 16 tooth gear on it drives a 16 tooth idler, which drives the crankshaft, pumping the eight pistons, and a chain from the crankshaft turns the supercharger's pulley on top of the engine.
functions.source: book: steps 58-73 (differential and drive shaft), page 228 (the engine and supercharger shown), page 228 bottom-left inset (arrow at the rear wheel)
functions.note: inferred: that the supercharger is driven by the chain, from the chain links round p443

functions.does: The rear differential lets the rear wheels turn at different speeds in a bend.
functions.note: with the drive shaft held still, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way

functions.does: The front wheels have independent suspension: each rides on a pair of suspension arms, sprung by its own shock absorber, and rises and falls on its own.
functions.source: book: page 228 top-left inset (up-and-down arrow at the front wheel and its shock)
functions.note: each arm moves its own side only; how far is set by the shock absorber's travel

functions.does: The front shock absorbers' springs push the front wheels back down.
functions.skip: a spring only matters under gravity or force

functions.does: The rear axle is sprung: the whole rear axle with its differential swings on a ball joint at the front of the drive shaft, held by two shock absorbers.
functions.source: inferred: the model has two shock absorbers (p101/p102 and p105/p106) between the frame and the rear axle's frame; the book draws no arrow for it

functions.does: The rear shock absorbers' springs push the rear axle back down.
functions.skip: a spring only matters under gravity or force

functions.does: The bonnet opens: it lifts on hinges at the windscreen end to show the engine and supercharger.
functions.source: book: page 229 top inset (arrow on the bonnet)

functions.does: The boot lid opens on its hinges at the back of the car.
functions.source: book: page 229 top inset (arrow at the boot lid)

functions.does: The red lever between the seats works the wheelie bar: pushing it swings a bar down under the car, so the car rears up as in the film.
functions.source: book: page 229 bottom inset (arrow on the lever in the cabin, arrow on the bar swinging down)
functions.note: inferred: which parts make the lever and bar, from the lever between the seats (p328, p332 on p329) that swings on the axle p326 and reaches under the floor (p463, p466); the book's inset is small

questions.question: Which parts are the wheelie lever and bar, and does the chain turn the supercharger?

why: p0 92910 has no joint to work
